channel.title: Once Upon a Time Show: Bedtime Stories
channel.description: Gentle bedtime stories for children, told slowly by a warm narrator. Each episode retells a classic, public-domain tale (Cinderella, Hansel and Gretel, King Midas and more) in simple words, with soft music between the scenes and a calm goodnight at the end. The tales are adapted for bedtime, so nothing is too scary. Scripts and voices are made with AI, and every episode credits its source and its music. Also in French and Vietnamese.

item.title: The Three Little Pigs, a bedtime story
item.description:
A gentle bedtime retelling of The Three Little Pigs, from Joseph Jacobs's English Fairy Tales, on D. L. Ashliman's Three Little Pigs page.
A house of straw, a house of sticks, a house of bricks, and a clever little pig who outsmarts the wolf with turnips, apples and a butter churn.
Nobody is eaten: the wolf splashes into cold water, runs off for good, and the story ends with a quiet goodnight.
Source: Three Little Pigs (https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/type0124.html)
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): "Music Box Theme", "Call to Adventure", "Marty Gots a Plan", "Golly Gee", "Carefree", "Sleep and Then". Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (excerpts, edited: trimmed, resampled, faded; the mood clips also loudness-normalised)
Written and voiced with AI (OpenRouter · heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo:free).

item.title: Little Red Riding Hood, a bedtime story
item.description:
A gentle bedtime retelling of Little Red Riding Hood, from the Brothers Grimm's Little Red Cap as translated by D. L. Ashliman.
A sneaky wolf, a grandmother hiding in her cupboard, and a hunter who sends the wolf running back to the woods.
Nobody is hurt, a second wolf slips into a tub of sausage water, and the story ends with a quiet goodnight.
Source: Little Red Cap (https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/grimm026.html)
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): "Music Box Theme", "Dreamy Flashback", "Marty Gots a Plan", "Carefree", "Golly Gee", "Sleep and Then". item.title: Hansel and Gretel, a bedtime story
item.description:
A gentle bedtime retelling of Hansel and Gretel, from the Brothers Grimm's tale as translated by D. L. Ashliman.
Shining pebbles, a house made of bread and cake, and a clever sister who sets her brother free.
A kind white duck carries them home to their father, and the story ends with a quiet goodnight.
Source: Hansel and Gretel (https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/grimm015.html)
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): "Music Box Theme", "Call to Adventure", "Dreamy Flashback", "Marty Gots a Plan", "Carefree", "Winner Winner!", "Sleep and Then". item.title: King Midas and the Golden Touch
item.description:
A gentle bedtime retelling of King Midas, from Nathaniel Hawthorne's "The Golden Touch".
A king who loved gold gets his wish: everything he touches turns to gold, even his little daughter Marygold.
River water makes all right again, and he learns what is worth more than gold.
Source: THE GOLDEN TOUCH. (https://www.ibiblio.org/eldritch/nh/wb2b.html)
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): "Music Box Theme", "Carefree", "Dreamy Flashback", "Golly Gee", "Touching Moments Four - Melody", "Call to Adventure", "Sleep and Then". item.title: Cinderella, a bedtime story
item.description:
A gentle bedtime retelling of Cinderella, from Charles Perrault's tale as translated by Andrew Lang.
A kind girl, a fairy godmother, a pumpkin coach and a glass slipper that fits just right.
It ends with forgiveness and a quiet goodnight: being kind is the best magic of all.
Source: Cinderella; or, The Little Glass Slipper (https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/perrault06.html)
Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): "Music Box Theme", "Carefree", "Dreamy Flashback", "Marty Gots a Plan", "Winner Winner!", "Sleep and Then".
